description.value: Taco Rio is a lively Mexican taqueria on Hot Springs Road in Harrison Hot Springs, serving street-style tacos by the pound, nachos, freshly-piped churros, and housemade drinks like vegan horchata and agua de jamaica. The spot offers online ordering with pickup, gift cards, and catering, making it a flexible stop for groups or solo riders. Its bold street-food menu and proximity to the Harrison Hot Springs resort area make it a natural refuelling point for cyclists passing through the Fraser Valley.

address.value: 791 Hot Springs Road, Harrison Hot Springs, BC V0M 1K0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms all OSM contact details (address 791 Hot Springs Rd, phone 604-796-0333) with a live 2026 menu and online ordering system, establishing the business as open. The menu explicitly labels two drinks as 'Vegan' (horchata and hibiscus tea), confirming vegan options. Pickup/takeout is confirmed by the 'Pickup from 791 Hot Springs Rd' prompt and Square checkout integration; no evidence exists for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or tech amenities.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active Mexican restaurant with a live website, confirmed address, and online ordering — a useful food stop for touring cyclists in Harrison Hot Springs.
enrichment_extras.notes: Email tacorioeats@gmail.com found on website but not present in OSM tags; could be added.
